integrity: An exact combinatorial proof and Poisson factorial-moment argument are provided. A standalone finite-state exhaustive check for orders 3 through 14 supports but does not certify the all-order theorem.
scientific_limitations: Binary synchronous nearest-neighbor majority on labelled simple cycles only; periodic-entry time not consensus time. The Poisson limit requires a convergent lattice scale and does not imply a non-subsequential continuous Gumbel law. Independent audit not performed. Historical priority risk remains for run-pattern statistics.
title: Exact stabilization-time tails and a Poisson cutoff for majority dynamics on rings
